difficultyRationale: Checks the exact return contract of one of the most common character-input methods.
prompt: Which statements about `BufferedReader.readLine()` are correct? Select all that apply.
explanation: `readLine` returns a line of text without the line-termination characters. It returns null when the end of the stream has been reached without another line.

options.text: The returned string excludes the line-termination characters.
options.explanation: The terminator is not part of the returned line.

options.text: It returns null when the end of the stream has been reached and no line remains.
options.explanation: Null is the documented end-of-stream result.

options.text: It always includes `\n` at the end of the returned string.
It returns an empty string instead of null for end of stream.
options.explanation: An empty line and end of stream are distinct; EOF is reported with null.
